final: SELECT AVG(step1_avg) as avg_instownpct, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) as step1_avg, AVG(instownpct) - (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals) as difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) > (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals))
